view.label: OMC Controlled Values
view.definition: Every controlled value OMC-JSON defines, named the way OMC-JSON names it, so a build process can regenerate a schema table from it and be sure it is current.

children.label: script
children.definition: A Structured Document written as a blueprint to convey the creative intent for the Creative Work. Parsing the Script generates a guide to those things that are to be depicted in production.

children.label: proxy
children.definition: A lower quality representation of an Asset.

children.label: proxy.editorial
children.definition: A type of video proxy.

children.label: proxy.daily
children.definition: A type of video proxy.

children.label: color
children.definition: Asset containing information about color.

children.label: color.lut
children.definition: Look up table

notes.value: A look up table is an array, either two or three dimensional, that changes the way an image looks. For example, a LUT can be used to transform an image from one color space to another

children.label: color.cdl
children.definition: Color Decision List, describes suggested correct color for each shot.

children.label: color.colorSpace
children.definition: A predefined encoding for communicating color appearance.

children.label: productionSetDressing
children.definition: Assets used in the depiction of Narrative Set Dressing.

children.label: productionSetDressing.productionVehicle
children.definition: An Asset used in the Depiction of a Narrative Vehicle

children.label: productionSetDressing.productionGreenery
children.definition: An Asset or Assets used to depict Narrative greenery in a Production Scene.

children.label: map
children.definition: An image intended to drive or influence a behavior or value within a CG workflow.

children.label: productionProp
children.definition: An Asset used in the Depiction of a Narrative Prop.

children.label: productionProp.productionVehicle
children.definition: An Asset used in the Depiction of a Narrative Vehicle

children.label: productionProp.productionGreenery
children.definition: An Asset or Assets used to depict Narrative greenery in a Production Scene.

children.label: material
children.definition: Data values and relationships required to describe the look of a CG Asset.

children.label: costume
children.definition: An Asset used to depict the Narrative Wardrobe of a Character.

children.label: artwork
children.definition: Illustrations, photographs, or other materials that illustrate some aspect of a Creative Work.

children.label: artwork.storyboard
children.definition: A series of images that forms a visual representation of some part of the narrative.

children.label: artwork.animatedStoryboard
children.definition: A moving image produced from the individual images of a Storyboard.

children.label: artwork.conceptArt
children.definition: Images that illustrate ideas for potential depictions of elements of the creative intent.

children.label: configuration
children.definition: Asset that contains information about the configuration of components of the workflow.

children.label: configuration.colorSpace
children.definition: A configuration file for a color management system.

children.label: technicalReferenceMaterial
children.definition: Images, documents, data, or other material created as part of the execution of the production.

children.label: shot
children.definition: A discrete unit of visual narrative with a specified beginning and end.

children.label: shot.animation
children.definition: A Shot that has been identified as requiring Animation work.

children.label: shot.vfx
children.definition: A Shot that has been identified as requiring VFX work.

children.label: shot.editorial
children.definition: A shot that has been marked for editorial use.

children.label: sequenceChronologyDescriptor
children.definition: Describes how a series of Shots is used to generate a Sequence.

children.label: capture
children.definition: The result of recording any event by any means.

children.label: capture.ocf
children.definition: Original Captured Footage, A moving image captured from a camera.

children.label: capture.lidar
children.definition: Light Detecting and Ranging, a capture from a specialized scanning device that creates a point cloud.

children.label: capture.witnessCamera
children.definition: A video capture not intended for the creative work, but as a record of related action, typically on-set.

children.label: capture.roll
children.definition: Identifier for a group of events captured together on the same camera and recording media.

children.label: capture.faceCamera
children.definition: A capture of an actor's face, often used for motion capture.

children.label: capture.motionCapture
children.definition: The recording of motion as a stream of digital data.

children.label: capture.calibration
children.definition: Captured calibration data from a device.

children.label: capture.cameraProxy
children.definition: A proxy directly generated by the camera.

children.label: creativeReferenceMaterial
children.definition: Images or other material used to inform the artistic aspects of creation of a production, to help convey a tone or look, etc.

children.label: cgModel
children.definition: A generic use for Geometry.

children.label: cameraMetadata
children.definition: Capture-specific details and information about the Camera itself.

children.label: lensMetadata
children.definition: Capture-specific details and information about the Lens itself.

children.label: recorderMetadata
children.definition: Information about a Recorder and the recording media.

children.label: audio
children.definition: A representation of sound.

children.label: audio.track
children.definition: A temporally continuous sequence of related samples.

children.label: audio.channel
children.definition: A distinct collection of sequenced audio samples that are intended for delivery to a single loudspeaker or other reproduction device.

children.label: audio.object
children.definition: A segment of audio essence with associated metadata describing positional and other properties which may vary with time.

children.label: audio.mix
children.definition: A combination of multiple Audio Assets and Compositions into a particular format.

children.label: audio.objectMetadata
children.definition: A file containing metadata about the audio object.

children.label: productionCharacter
children.definition: An Asset used in the portrayal of a Character.

children.label: audioSession
children.definition: An Asset that represents the state of the audio mixing and editing process.

tree.label: AssetSC.structuralType
tree.definition: A canonical description of this assets form.

children.label: digital
children.definition: Information that exists as digital data.

children.label: digital.image
children.definition: A two-dimensional visual representation.

children.label: digital.movingImage
children.definition: A temporally ordered sequence of Images

children.label: digital.imageSequence
children.definition: A temporally ordered sequence of individual images which are the constituent parts of a Moving Image.

children.label: digital.audio
children.definition: A representation of sound.

children.label: digital.audioVisual
children.definition: A Moving Image with Audio synchronized to the images.

children.label: digital.document
children.definition: A human readable object containing text and/or images.

children.label: digital.structuredDocument
children.definition: A Document structured according to a set of rules which are used to parse or understand the document.

children.label: digital.data
children.definition: An Asset Structure composed of digital data.

children.label: digital.procedural
children.definition: An Asset Structure that produces data that does not persist outside of its immediate use.

children.label: physical
children.definition: A physical asset is one where the tangible reality of the Asset is its defining feature.

children.label: physical.image
children.definition: A two-dimensional visual representation.

children.label: physical.movingImage
children.definition: A temporally ordered sequence of Images

children.label: physical.imageSequence
children.definition: A temporally ordered sequence of individual images which are the constituent parts of a Moving Image.

children.label: physical.audioVisual
children.definition: A Moving Image with Audio synchronized to the images.

children.label: physical.document
children.definition: A human readable object containing text and/or images.

children.label: physical.structuredDocument
children.definition: A Document structured according to a set of rules which are used to parse or understand the document.

children.label: geometry
children.definition: A shape defined in three dimensions.

children.label: assetGroup
children.definition: Signifies this Asset represents and Asset Group.

tree.label: NarrativeAudio.narrativeType
tree.definition: The specific type of narrative audio.

children.label: narrativeAudio
children.definition: A significant sound in the narrative.

children.label: music
children.definition: Music that is implicitly or explicitly used to advance or support the narrative.

children.label: soundEffect
children.definition: A sound that explicitly or implicitly advances or supports the narrative.

children.label: narrativeProp
children.definition: A Prop as specified or implied by the narrative.

children.label: narrativeSetDressing
children.definition: Set Dressing as implied or specified by the narrative.

children.label: narrativeGreenery
children.definition: Plant material and terrain-building material described or implied in the narrative,

notes.value: this covers living plants (potted ferns, planted trees, fields of daffodils, etc.) and cut plants (e.g. single flowers, daisy chains, and sprigs of mistletoe) as well as rocks, sand, etc.

children.label: narrativeVehicle
children.definition: Any mode of transport specified or implied by the narrative.

tree.label: Character.characterType
tree.definition: The specific type of character.

children.label: extra
children.definition: A sentient entity (usually a person, but not always) in the Script whose specific identity is minimally consequential to the narrative.

children.label: character
children.definition: A sentient entity (usually a person but not always) in the script whose specific identity is consequential to the narrative. A Character is generally identified by a specific name.

tree.label: Context.contextType
tree.definition: The specific type of context.

children.label: narrative
children.definition: Gathers relationships for narrative entities.

children.label: production
children.definition: A real place that is used when producing the Creative Work.

examples.value: Sound Stage 3 can be used to create the depiction of 'MegaCorp boardroom', and the estate at West Wycombe Park is used to depict some locations in Pride and Prejudice and Zombies.

children.label: shootDay
children.definition: The number of the day on the filming schedule.

children.label: concept
children.definition: An exploratory representation of something from the narrative.

notes.value: Concept covers anything that is used or created as input to the final depiction of a narrative element in the Creative Work, including storyboards, concept art, costume ideas, possible filming locations, and so on.

tree.label: Depiction.depictionType
tree.definition: The specific type of creative work.

children.label: depiction
children.definition: The representation of a Narrative Entity (See Part 2A: Narrative Elements) by a production entity in the Creative Work, specified or implied by the Script.

children.label: portrayal
children.definition: The Depiction of a Character.

tree.label: Composition.compositionType
tree.definition: The specific type of composition.

children.label: sequence
children.definition: An ordered collection of media used to organize units of work.

children.label: sequence.animation
children.definition: A unit of work made up of an ordered series of Animation shots.

notes.value: Shots with both live action and animation would be a VFX Shot

children.label: sequence.color
children.definition: A sequence of shots with color grading characteristics linked to creative intent.

children.label: sequence.editorial
children.definition: A Sequence of Editorial Shots linked to creative intent.

notes.value: Typically has a close relationship to narrative intent

children.label: sequence.vfxImage
children.definition: An Image Sequence used in VFX work.

children.label: sequence.vfx
children.definition: A unit of work made up of an ordered series of VFX shots.

notes.value: May not be a continuous narrative
A collection and grouping mechanism, usually associated with a scope of work

children.label: cgAssembly
children.definition: A Composition that includes a collection of related CG Assets and CG Assemblies.

children.label: compositeMaterial
children.definition: A Material represented by a Composition.

children.label: geometryAssembly
children.definition: A Composition containing only Geometry information.

children.label: audio
children.definition: A Composition consisting of audio assets, Audio Compositions, and an Audio Session.

children.label: audio.soundEditorialUnit
children.definition: A collection of sound samples that have been selected in reference to the Creative Work or a portion of it.

children.label: audio.preMix
children.definition: A collection of sound samples that have been processed for technical or creative review.

children.label: audio.stem
children.definition: Final Audio Assets and Compositions combined based on their Audio Classification, used to produce the final sound for the Creative Work in a particular Soundfield.

children.label: audio.bed
children.definition: The Channel component of an immersive STEM or Printmaster.

children.label: audio.printmaster
children.definition: The combination of STEMs for a particular soundfield at unity gain.

tree.label: NarrativeLocation.narrativeType
tree.definition: The specific type of narrative location.

children.label: narrativeLocation
children.definition: A location specified or implied by the narrative.

notes.value: These can be real (e.g., a documentary comparing Soho in London to Soho in New York), fictionalized real (e.g., The White House, as it exists in the narrative), or completely imaginary (e.g., Tatooine.)

tree.label: NarrativeObject.narrativeType
tree.definition: The specific type of narrative object.

children.label: narrativeProp
children.definition: A Prop as specified or implied by the narrative.

children.label: narrativeObject
children.definition: A significant tangible thing in the narrative.

children.label: narrativeSetDressing
children.definition: Set Dressing as implied or specified by the narrative.

children.label: narrativeGreenery
children.definition: Plant material and terrain-building material described or implied in the narrative,

notes.value: this covers living plants (potted ferns, planted trees, fields of daffodils, etc.) and cut plants (e.g. single flowers, daisy chains, and sprigs of mistletoe) as well as rocks, sand, etc.

children.label: narrativeVehicle
children.definition: Any mode of transport specified or implied by the narrative.

tree.label: NarrativeScene.narrativeType
tree.definition: The specific type of narrative scene.

children.label: narrativeScene
children.definition: Taken from the narrative itself and traditionally defined by creative intent and various kinds of unity (e.g., time, place, action, or theme).

tree.label: NarrativeStyling.narrativeType
tree.definition: The specific type of narrative styling.

children.label: narrativeProsthetics
children.definition: The use of molding, casting, and sculpting techniques to create the required look for a Character.

children.label: narrativeHair
children.definition: Hair requirements, procuring and maintaining wigs, and styling and cutting the hair of Participants in Portrayals.

children.label: narrativeMakeup
children.definition: Application and Maintenance of make-up for anyone appearing on-screen.

children.label: narrativeStyling
children.definition: Element of the narrative that directly influence the appearance of a Character, including hair, makeup, and prosthetics.

tree.label: NarrativeWardrobe.narrativeType
tree.definition: The specific type of narrative wardrobe.

children.label: narrativeWardrobe
children.definition: The clothing for a Character in the narrative.

tree.label: SpecialAction.specialActionType
tree.definition: The specific type of special action.

children.label: motionCapture
children.definition: The recording of motion as a stream of digital data.

children.label: aerial
children.definition: Anything involving work with equipment that flies.

children.label: choreography
children.definition: The creation, arrangement, and management of dance.

children.label: fight
children.definition: Action in a Narrative Scene that will require involving a specialist such as a Fight Coordinator in the production process.

children.label: marine
children.definition: Anything involving work on water or in water-borne craft.

children.label: stunt
children.definition: Physical action described or implied in the narrative that would put an actor in some kind of danger and so requires a specialist to manage and coordinate.

children.label: specialAction
children.definition: Describes the use or purpose of an Asset within the production process.

tree.label: Effect.effectType
tree.definition: The specific type of creative work.

children.label: effect
children.definition: A technique that creates or enhances visual elements in the finished work

children.label: specialEffect
children.definition: Physically based effects, such as explosions, the use of mannequins, and the use of models, the results of which are captured on-camera.

children.label: visualEffect
children.definition: Effects created on or in the footage after it is captured.

notes.value: Has Participant Structural Class of Organization

tree.label: gender.genderPronoun
tree.definition: An individual's pronoun of choice.

tree.label: gender.identifiesAs
tree.definition: The gender by which an individual identifies.

children.label: mesh
children.definition: A geometry type

children.label: y-up
children.definition: The Y coordinate is the elevation axis.

children.label: z-up
children.definition: The Z coordinate is the elevation axis.

tree.definition: Relates non-narrative entities, the inverse of has.

children.label: rendering
children.definition: Final high-quality visual output of 3D geometry.

children.label: proxy
children.definition: Lower-resolution geometry used for faster pre-visualization and playback.

children.label: collision
children.definition: Simplified geometry for collision detection and physics simulations.

children.label: guide
children.definition: Geometry used as a visual guide or reference in animation and VFX.

children.label: matte/paint
children.definition: Geometry that acts as a background or underlay for visual atmosphere creation.

children.label: annotation
children.definition: 3D elements that provide additional information or commentary on other geometry.

children.label: printing
children.definition: Geometry built as input for a 3D printer process

tree.label: compositionProperties.materialType
tree.definition: A categorization of what the material is intended to simulate.

tree.label: CreativeWork.creativeWorkType
tree.definition: The specific type of creative work.

children.label: series
children.definition: A group of Creative Works with a common overarching title and a strong relationship between the individual Creative Works.

children.label: season
children.definition: A group of Episodes in a Series that are made or distributed together.

children.label: creativeWork
children.definition: A uniquely identified production.

children.label: episode
children.definition: A single Creative Work that is part of Series or Season

children.label: supplemental
children.definition: Material created to support some other work, such as a trailer, featurette, deleted scenes, gag reel, interviews, behind-the-scenes, etc.

children.label: movie
children.definition: A feature film or other long-from motion picture that first appeared in theatrical exhibition or was released directly to video (home entertainment). If the duration is ≤ 40 minutes, then the record

children.label: tv
children.definition: Content that first appeared via broadcast (terrestrial, satellite, cable, etc.). This includes telefilms, other one-off programs, and Episodes of television series.

children.label: short
children.definition: A short program (≤ 40 minutes) that first appeared in theatrical exhibition or was released directly to video (home entertainment). If the duration is > 40 minutes, then the record is a Movie.

tree.label: creativeWorkTitle.titleType
tree.definition: The specific type of title.

children.label: internal
children.definition: An internal title or code name, not used in commercial release.

children.label: working
children.definition: Working title, used during the course of production.

children.label: regional
children.definition: A title unique to a particular territory or otherwise used outside the work’s original home territory, such as local titles given to foreign imports. May be in the same language as the Release title.

children.label: release
children.definition: The original release title for the work.

tree.label: ProductionLocation.locationType

children.label: production
children.definition: A real place that is used when producing the Creative Work.

children.label: shooting

examples.value: Sound Stage 3 can be used to create the depiction of 'MegaCorp boardroom', and the estate at West Wycombe Park is used to depict some locations in Pride and Prejudice and Zombies.
